shloka_text: कैलासं लङ्घयित्वाथ दशग्रीवः स रावणः । आससाद महातेजा इन्द्रलोकं निशाचरः ।। 7.27.1 ।।
transliteration: kailāsaṃ laṅghayitvātha daśagrīvaḥ sa rāvaṇaḥ | āsasāda mahātejā indralokaṃ niśācaraḥ || 7.27.1 ||
translation: कैलासं Kailasam, Kailasa mountain, लङ्घयित्वाथ laṅghayitvā atha, having crossed, then, दशग्रीवः daśagrīvaḥ, ten-necked, स sa, that, रावणः rāvaṇaḥ, Ravana, आससाद āsasāda, reached, महातेजा mahātejā, greatly powerful, इन्द्रलोकं indralokaṃ, Indra's world, निशाचरः niśācaraḥ, night-wanderer.
explanation: After crossing the Kailasa mountain, that greatly powerful ten-necked demon Ravana reached the world of Indra.
comments: Ravana reaches Indra's heaven -- the fearful Indra seeks Vishnu's aid, but Vishnu, declining to fight the boon-protected Ravana now, vows to be the cause of his death in time -- the gods sally forth and battle is joined -- Ravana's grandfather Sumali rampages through the divine host until the Vasu Savitra crushes him to ashes with his mace, and the rakshasas flee.

shloka_text: तस्य राक्षससैन्यस्य समन्तादुपयास्यतः । देवलोकं ययौ शब्दो मथ्यमानार्णवोपमः ।। 7.27.2 ।।
transliteration: tasya rākṣasasainyasya samantādupayāsyataḥ | devalokaṃ yayau śabdo mathyamānārṇavopamaḥ || 7.27.2 ||
translation: तस्य tasya, of that, राक्षससैन्यस्य rākṣasasainyasya, of the demon army, समन्तादुपयास्यतः samantādupayāsyataḥ, approaching from all sides, देवलोकं devalokaṃ, to the world of gods, ययौ yayau, went, शब्दो śabdo, sound, मथ्यमानार्णवोपमः mathyamānārṇavopamaḥ, like the churning ocean.
explanation: The sound of that demon army approaching from all sides reached the world of the gods, resembling the roar of a churning ocean.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा तु रावणं प्राप्तमिन्द्रश्चलित आसनात् । अब्रवीत्तत्र तान् देवान् सर्वानेव समागतान् ।। 7.27.3 ।।
transliteration: śrutvā tu rāvaṇaṃ prāptamindraścalita āsanāt | abravīttatra tān devān sarvāneva samāgatān || 7.27.3 ||
translation: श्रुत्वा śrutvā, having heard, तु tu, indeed, रावणं rāvaṇaṃ, Ravana, प्राप्तम् prāptam, arrived, इन्द्रश्चलित indraścalita, Indra moved, आसनात् āsanāt, from his seat, अब्रवीत्तत्र abravīttatra, spoke there, तान् tān, to those, देवान् devān, gods, सर्वानेव sarvāneva, all indeed, समागतान् samāgatān, assembled.
explanation: Having heard that Ravana had arrived, Indra moved from his seat and spoke to all the assembled gods there.

shloka_text: आदित्यान्सवसून्रुद्रान्विश्वान्साध्यान्मरुद्गणान् । सज्जीभवत युद्धार्थं रावणस्य दुरात्मनः ।। 7.27.4 ।।
transliteration: ādityānsavasūnrudrānviśvānsādhyānmarudgaṇān | sajjībhavata yuddhārthaṃ rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ || 7.27.4 ||
translation: आदित्यान्सवसून्रुद्रान्विश्वान्साध्यान्मरुद्गणान् ādityānsavasūnrudrānviśvānsādhyānmarudgaṇān, Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, Vishvas, Sadhyas, Maruts, सज्जीभवत sajjībhavata, be ready, युद्धार्थं yuddhārthaṃ, for battle, रावणस्य rāvaṇasya, of Ravana, दुरात्मनः durātmanaḥ, the evil-minded.
explanation: He commanded the Adityas, Vasus, Rudras, Vishvas, Sadhyas, and Maruts to prepare for battle against the evil-minded Ravana.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तास्तु शक्रेण देवाः शक्रसमा युधि । सन्नह्य सुमहासत्त्वा युद्धश्रद्धासमन्विताः ।। 7.27.5 ।।
transliteration: evamuktāstu śakreṇa devāḥ śakrasamā yudhi | sannahya sumahāsattvā yuddhaśraddhāsamanvitāḥ || 7.27.5 ||
translation: एवमुक्तास्तु evamuktāstu, thus spoken indeed, शक्रेण śakreṇa, by Indra, देवाः devāḥ, gods, शक्रसमा śakrasamā, equal to Indra, युधि yudhi, in battle, सन्नह्य sannahya, having armored themselves, सुमहासत्त्वा sumahāsattvā, very great-spirited, युद्धश्रद्धासमन्विताः yuddhaśraddhāsamanvitāḥ, filled with eagerness for battle.
explanation: Thus addressed by Indra, the gods, who were as mighty as Indra in battle and possessed great courage, armored themselves, filled with eagerness for the fight.

shloka_text: स तु दीनः परित्रस्तो महेन्द्रो रावणं प्रति । विष्णोः समीपमागत्य वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। 7.27.6 ।।
transliteration: sa tu dīnaḥ paritrasto mahendro rāvaṇaṃ prati | viṣṇoḥ samīpamāgatya vākyametaduvāca ha || 7.27.6 ||
translation: सः he, तु indeed, दीनः distressed, परित्रस्तः greatly frightened, महेन्द्रः Mahendra (Indra), रावणं Ravana, प्रति towards, विष्णोः of Vishnu, समीपम् near, आगत्य having come, वाक्यम् words, एतत् these, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.
explanation: Distressed and greatly frightened by Ravana, Indra indeed approached Vishnu and spoke these words.

shloka_text: विष्णो कथं करिष्यामि महावीर्यपराक्रमः । असौ हि बलवद्रक्षो युद्धार्थमभिवर्तते ।। 7.27.7 ।।
transliteration: viṣṇo kathaṃ kariṣyāmi mahāvīryaparākramaḥ | asau hi balavadrakṣo yuddhārthamabhivartate || 7.27.7 ||
translation: विष्णो O Vishnu, कथं how, करिष्यामि shall I act, महावीर्यपराक्रमः of great valor and might, असौ this one, हि indeed, बलवत् powerful, रक्षः demon, युद्धार्थम् for battle, अभिवर्तते approaches.
explanation: O Vishnu, how shall I act, for this demon of great valor and might, this powerful Rakshasa, is indeed approaching for battle.

shloka_text: वरप्रदानाद्बलवान्न खल्वन्येन हेतुना । तत्तु सत्यवचः कार्यं यदुक्तं पद्मयोनिना ।। 7.27.8 ।।
transliteration: varapradānādbalavānna khalvanyena hetunā | tattu satyavacaḥ kāryaṃ yaduktaṃ padmayoninā || 7.27.8 ||
translation: वरप्रदानात् due to the boon, बलवान् powerful, न not, खलु indeed, अन्येन by any other, हेतुना reason, तत् that, तु indeed, सत्यवचः true word, कार्यं should be made, यत् which, उक्तं was spoken, पद्मयोनिना by Brahma.
explanation: He is powerful due to the boon granted, and not for any other reason; therefore, that true word spoken by Brahma must indeed be fulfilled.

shloka_text: तद्यथा नमुचिर्वृत्रो बलिर्नरकशम्बरौ । त्वद्बलं समवष्टभ्य मया दग्धास्तथा कुरु ।। 7.27.9 ।।
transliteration: tadyathā namucirvṛtro balirnarakaśambarau | tvadbalaṃ samavaṣṭabhya mayā dagdhāstathā kuru || 7.27.9 ||
translation: तत् therefore, यथा just as, नमुचिः Namuchi, वृत्रः Vritra, बलिः Bali, नरक Naraka, शम्बरौ and Shambara, त्वद्बलं your strength, समवष्टभ्य having relied upon, मया by me, दग्धाः were destroyed, तथा so, कुरु do.
explanation: Therefore, just as Namuchi, Vritra, Bali, Naraka, and Shambara were destroyed by me with the support of your strength, so too act now.

shloka_text: नह्यन्यो देवदेवेश त्वामृते मधुसूदन । गतिः परायणं नास्ति त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे ।। 7.27.10 ।।
transliteration: nahyanyo devadeveśa tvāmṛte madhusūdana | gatiḥ parāyaṇaṃ nāsti trailokye sacarācare || 7.27.10 ||
translation: न not, हि indeed, अन्यः another, देवदेवेश O Lord of gods, त्वाम् you, ऋते without, मधुसूदन O Madhusudana, गतिः refuge, परायणं ultimate resort, न not, अस्ति is, त्रैलोक्ये in the three worlds, सचराचरे with all moving and non-moving beings.
explanation: Indeed, O Lord of gods, O Madhusudana, there is no other refuge or ultimate resort in the three worlds, with all their moving and non-moving beings, except for you.

shloka_text: त्वं हि नारायणः श्रीमान्पद्मनाभः सनातनः । त्वयेमे स्थापिता लोकाः शक्रश्चाहं सुरेश्वरः ।। 7.27.11 ।।
transliteration: tvaṃ hi nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmānpadmanābhaḥ sanātanaḥ | tvayeme sthāpitā lokāḥ śakraścāhaṃ sureśvaraḥ || 7.27.11 ||
translation: त्वं you, हि indeed, नारायणः Narayana, श्रीमान् glorious, पद्मनाभः lotus-navelled, सनातनः eternal, त्वया by you, इमे these, स्थापिताः established, लोकाः worlds, शक्रः Indra, च and, अहं I, सुरेश्वरः lord of gods.
explanation: Indra acknowledges Rama as the glorious, eternal Narayana, the lotus-navelled one, by whom all these worlds, including Indra himself as the lord of gods, were established.

shloka_text: त्वया सृष्टमिदं सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् । त्वामेव भगवन्सर्वे प्रविशन्ति युगक्षये ।। 7.27.12 ।।
transliteration: tvayā sṛṣṭamidaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram | tvāmeva bhagavansarve praviśanti yugakṣaye || 7.27.12 ||
translation: त्वया by you, सृष्टम् created, इदं this, सर्वं all, त्रैलोक्यं three worlds, सचराचरम् with moving and non-moving beings, त्वाम् into you, एव indeed, भगवन् O Lord, सर्वे all, प्रविशन्ति enter, युगक्षये at the dissolution of the age.
explanation: Indra further states that all these three worlds, with their moving and non-moving beings, were created by the Lord, and at the end of an age, all beings ultimately merge back into Him.

shloka_text: तदाचक्ष्व यथा तत्त्वं देवदेव मम स्वयम् । अपि चक्रसहायस्त्वं योत्स्यसे रावणं प्रभो ।। 7.27.13 ।।
transliteration: tadācakṣva yathā tattvaṃ devadeva mama svayam | api cakrasahāyastvaṃ yotsyase rāvaṇaṃ prabho || 7.27.13 ||
translation: तत् therefore, आचक्ष्व tell, यथा how, तत्त्वं truly, देवदेव O God of gods, मम to me, स्वयम् yourself, अपि whether, चक्रसहायः aided by your discus, त्वं you, योत्स्यसे will fight, रावणं Ravana, प्रभो O Lord.
explanation: Indra implores the Lord of gods to reveal truly how He, even with the aid of His discus, intends to fight Ravana.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तः स शक्रेण देवो नारायणः प्रभुः । अब्रवीन्न परित्रासः कर्तव्यः श्रूयतां च मे ।। 7.27.14 ।।
transliteration: evamuktaḥ sa śakreṇa devo nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ | abravīnna paritrāsaḥ kartavyaḥ śrūyatāṃ ca me || 7.27.14 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्तः addressed, सः that, शक्रेण by Indra, देवः god, नारायणः Narayana, प्रभुः the Lord, अब्रवीत् said, न not, परित्रासः great fear, कर्तव्यः should be entertained, श्रूयतां let it be heard, च and, मे by me.
explanation: Thus addressed by Indra, the Lord Narayana replied that there was no need for such great fear, and asked Indra to listen to His words.

shloka_text: न तावदेष दुष्टात्मा शक्यो जेतुं सुरासुरैः । हन्तुं चापि समासाद्य वरदानेन दुर्जयः ।। 7.27.15 ।।
transliteration: na tāvadeṣa duṣṭātmā śakyo jetuṃ surāsuraiḥ | hantuṃ cāpi samāsādya varadānena durjayaḥ || 7.27.15 ||
translation: न not, तावत् indeed, एषः this, दुष्टात्मा evil-souled one, शक्यः possible, जेतुम् to conquer, सुरासुरैः by gods and asuras, हन्तुं to kill, च and, अपि even, समासाद्य having approached, वरदानेन by the boon, दुर्जयः unconquerable.
explanation: The Lord explained that this evil-souled Ravana is currently unconquerable by gods or asuras, and cannot be killed even if approached, due to the boon he has received.

shloka_text: सर्वथा तु महत्कर्म करिष्यति बलोत्कटः । राक्षसः पुत्रसहितो दृष्टमेतन्निसर्गतः ।। 7.27.16 ।।
transliteration: sarvathā tu mahatkarma kariṣyati balotkaṭaḥ | rākṣasaḥ putrasahito dṛṣṭametannisargataḥ || 7.27.16 ||
translation: सर्वथा certainly, तु indeed, महत्कर्म a great deed, करिष्यति will perform, बलोत्कटः exceedingly powerful, राक्षसः the demon, पुत्रसहितो along with his sons, दृष्टम् seen, एतत् this, निसर्गतः by nature.
explanation: It is inherently observed that this exceedingly powerful demon, along with his sons, will certainly perform a great deed.

shloka_text: यत्तु मां त्वमभाषिष्ठ युद्ध्यस्वेति सुरेश्वर । नाहं तं प्रतियोत्स्यामि रावणं राक्षसं युधि ।। 7.27.17 ।।
transliteration: yattu māṃ tvamabhāṣiṣṭha yuddhyasveti sureśvara | nāhaṃ taṃ pratiyotsyāmi rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasaṃ yudhi || 7.27.17 ||
translation: यत् that which, तु but, माम् me, त्वम् you, अभाषिष्ठ spoke, युद्ध्यस्व fight, इति thus, सुरेश्वर O lord of gods, न not, अहम् I, तम् him, प्रतियोत्स्यामि will fight against, रावणम् Ravana, राक्षसम् the demon, युधि in battle.
explanation: O lord of gods, regarding what you told me to fight, I will not fight against that demon Ravana in battle.

shloka_text: नाहत्वा समरे शत्रुं विष्णुः प्रतिनिवर्तते । दुर्लभश्चैव कामो ऽद्य वरगुप्ताद्धि रावणात् ।। 7.27.18 ।।
transliteration: nāhatvā samare śatruṃ viṣṇuḥ pratinivartate | durlabhaścaiva kāmo 'dya varaguptāddhi rāvaṇāt || 7.27.18 ||
translation: न not, अहत्वा without killing, समरे in battle, शत्रुम् the enemy, विष्णुः Vishnu, प्रतिनिवर्तते returns, दुर्लभः difficult to obtain, च and, एव indeed, कामः the desire, अद्य now, वरगुप्तात् protected by boons, हि indeed, रावणात् from Ravana.
explanation: Vishnu does not return from battle without killing the enemy, and indeed, it is difficult to fulfill this desire now because Ravana is protected by boons.

shloka_text: प्रतिजाने च देवेन्द्र त्वत्समीपे शतक्रतो । भविता ऽस्मि यथा ऽस्याहं रक्षसो मृत्युकारणम् ।। 7.27.19 ।।
transliteration: pratijāne ca devendra tvatsamīpe śatakrato | bhavitā 'smi yathā 'syāhaṃ rakṣaso mṛtyukāraṇam || 7.27.19 ||
translation: प्रतिजाने I promise, च and, देवेन्द्र O king of gods, त्वत्समीपे in your presence, शतक्रतो O Shatakratu, भविता will be, अस्मि I am, यथा as, अस्य of this, अहम् I, रक्षसः of the demon, मृत्युकारणम् the cause of death.
explanation: And O king of gods, O Shatakratu, I promise in your presence that I shall indeed be the cause of this demon's death.

shloka_text: अहमेव निहन्ता ऽस्मि रावणं सपुरःसरम् । देवता नन्दयिष्यामि ज्ञात्वा कालमुपागतम् । एतत्ते कथितं तत्त्वं देवराज शचीपते ।। 7.27.20 ।।
transliteration: ahameva nihantā 'smi rāvaṇaṃ sapuraḥsaram | devatā nandayiṣyāmi jñātvā kālamupāgatam | etatte kathitaṃ tattvaṃ devarāja śacīpate || 7.27.20 ||
translation: अहम् I, एव alone, निहन्ता the killer, अस्मि I am, रावणम् Ravana, सपुरःसरम् along with his followers, देवताः the gods, नन्दयिष्यामि I will gladden, ज्ञात्वा having known, कालम् the time, उपागतम् arrived, एतत् this, ते to you, कथितम् told, तत्त्वम् the truth, देवराज O king of gods, शचीपते O husband of Shachi.
explanation: I alone will be the killer of Ravana along with his followers, and I will gladden the gods, knowing that the time has come; this truth has been told to you, O king of gods, husband of Shachi.

shloka_text: युद्ध्यस्व विगतत्रासः सर्वैः सार्धं महाबल ।। 7.27.21 ।।
transliteration: yuddhyasva vigatatrāsaḥ sarvaiḥ sārdhaṃ mahābala || 7.27.21 ||
translation: युद्ध्यस्व fight, विगतत्रासः fearless, सर्वैः with all, सार्धम् together, महाबल O mighty one.
explanation: O mighty one, fight fearlessly together with all.

shloka_text: यामि ज्ञात्वा कालमुपागतम् । ततो रुद्राः सहादित्या वसवो मरुतो ऽश्वनौ । सन्नद्धा निर्ययुस्तूर्णं राक्षसानभितः पुरात् ।। 7.27.22 ।।
transliteration: yāmi jñātvā kālamupāgatam | tato rudrāḥ sahādityā vasavo maruto 'śvanau | sannaddhā niryayustūrṇaṃ rākṣasānabhitaḥ purāt || 7.27.22 ||
translation: यामि I go, ज्ञात्वा having known, कालम् time, उपागतम् arrived. ततः then, रुद्राः the Rudras, सह with, आदित्याः the Adityas, वसवः the Vasus, मरुतः the Maruts, अश्वनौ the two Ashvins, सन्नद्धाः ready for battle, निर्ययुः went forth, तूर्णम् quickly, राक्षसान् towards the Rakshasas, अभितः around, पुरात् from the city.
explanation: Knowing that the time had come, I depart; then, the Rudras along with the Adityas, Vasus, Maruts, and the two Ashvins, arrayed for battle, quickly sallied forth from the city towards the Rakshasas.

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे नादः शुश्रुवे रजनीक्षये । तस्य रावणसैन्यस्य प्रयुद्धस्य समन्ततः ।। 7.27.23 ।।
transliteration: etasminnantare nādaḥ śuśruve rajanīkṣaye | tasya rāvaṇasainyasya prayuddhasya samantataḥ || 7.27.23 ||
translation: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, नादः a sound, शुश्रुवे was heard, रजनीक्षये at the end of the night, तस्य of that, रावणसैन्यस्य of Ravana's army, प्रयुद्धस्य fighting, समन्ततः from all sides.
explanation: In the meantime, at the end of the night, a roar was heard from all sides from Ravana's army, which was engaged in battle.

shloka_text: ते प्रयुद्धा महावीर्या ह्यन्योन्यमभिवीक्ष्य वै । सङ्ग्राममेवाभिमुखा ह्यभवर्तन्त हृष्टवत् ।। 7.27.24 ।।
transliteration: te prayuddhā mahāvīryā hyanyonyamabhivīkṣya vai | saṅgrāmamevābhimukhā hyabhavartanta hṛṣṭavat || 7.27.24 ||
translation: ते they, प्रयुद्धाः fighting, महावीर्याः of great valor, हि indeed, अन्योन्यम् each other, अभिवीक्ष्य having looked at, वै indeed, सङ्ग्रामम् battle, एव only, अभिमुखाः facing, हि indeed, अभवर्तन्त they advanced, हृष्टवत् joyfully.
explanation: Those mighty heroes, engaged in battle, looked at each other and advanced joyfully, intent only on the fight.

shloka_text: ततो दैवतसैन्यनां सङ्क्षोभः समजायत । तदक्षयं महासैन्यं दृष्ट्वा समरमूर्धनि ।। 7.27.25 ।।
transliteration: tato daivatasainyanāṃ saṅkṣobhaḥ samajāyata | tadakṣayaṃ mahāsainyaṃ dṛṣṭvā samaramūrdhani || 7.27.25 ||
translation: ततः then, दैवतसैन्यानाम् of the armies of the gods, सङ्क्षोभः agitation, समजायत arose, तत् that, अक्षयम् inexhaustible, महासैन्यम् great army, दृष्ट्वा having seen, समरमूर्धनि at the forefront of the battle.
explanation: Then, seeing that immense and inexhaustible great army at the forefront of the battle, agitation arose among the armies of the gods.

shloka_text: ततो युद्धं समभवेद्देवदानवरक्षसाम् । घोरं तुमुलनिर्ह्रादं नानाप्रहरणोद्यतम् ।। 7.27.26 ।।
transliteration: tato yuddhaṃ samabhaveddevadānavarakṣasām | ghoraṃ tumulanirhrādaṃ nānāpraharaṇodyatam || 7.27.26 ||
translation: ततो then, युद्धं a battle, समभवेत् occurred, देवदानवरक्षसाम् of gods, demons, and rakshasas, घोरं terrible, तुमुलनिर्ह्रादं with tumultuous roars, नानाप्रहरणोद्यतम् with various weapons raised.
explanation: Then, a terrible battle ensued among the gods, demons, and rakshasas, marked by tumultuous roars and the brandishing of various weapons.

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शूरा राक्षसा घोरदर्शनाः । युद्धार्थं समवर्तन्त सचिवा रावणस्य ते ।। 7.27.27 ।।
transliteration: etasminnantare śūrā rākṣasā ghoradarśanāḥ | yuddhārthaṃ samavartanta sacivā rāvaṇasya te || 7.27.27 ||
translation: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, शूराः valiant, राक्षसाः rakshasas, घोरदर्शनाः of terrible appearance, युद्धार्थं for battle, समवर्तन्त assembled, सचिवाः ministers, रावणस्य of Ravana, ते they.
explanation: In the meantime, Ravana's valiant ministers, the rakshasas of terrible appearance, assembled for battle.

shloka_text: मारीचश्च प्रहस्तश्च महापार्श्वमहोदरौ । अकम्पनो निकुम्भश्च शुकः सारण एव च ।। 7.27.28 ।।
transliteration: mārīcaśca prahastaśca mahāpārśvamahodarau | akampano nikumbhaśca śukaḥ sāraṇa eva ca || 7.27.28 ||
translation: मारीचः Maricha, च and, प्रहस्तः Prahasta, च and, महापार्श्वमहोदरौ Mahaparshva and Mahodara, अकम्पनः Akampana, निकुम्भः Nikumbha, च and, शुकः Shuka, सारणः Sarana, एव indeed, च and.
explanation: Maricha, Prahasta, Mahaparshva, Mahodara, Akampana, Nikumbha, Shuka, and Sarana were among them.

shloka_text: संह्लादो धूमकेतुश्च महादंष्ट्रो घटोदरः । जम्बुमाली महाह्रादो विरूपाक्षश्च राक्षसः ।। 7.27.29 ।।
transliteration: saṃhlādo dhūmaketuśca mahādaṃṣṭro ghaṭodaraḥ | jambumālī mahāhrādo virūpākṣaśca rākṣasaḥ || 7.27.29 ||
translation: संह्लादः Samhlada, धूमकेतुः Dhumaketu, च and, महादंष्ट्रः Mahadamshtra, घटोदरः Ghatodara, जम्बुमाली Jambumali, महाह्रादः Mahahrada, विरूपाक्षः Virupaksha, च and, राक्षसः rakshasa.
explanation: Also present were Samhlada, Dhumaketu, Mahadamshtra, Ghatodara, Jambumali, Mahahrada, and the rakshasa Virupaksha.

shloka_text: सुप्तघ्नो यज्ञकोपश्च दुर्मुखो दूषणः खरः । त्रिशिराः करवीराक्षः सूर्यशत्रुश्च राक्षसः ।। 7.27.30 ।।
transliteration: suptaghno yajñakopaśca durmukho dūṣaṇaḥ kharaḥ | triśirāḥ karavīrākṣaḥ sūryaśatruśca rākṣasaḥ || 7.27.30 ||
translation: सुप्तघ्नः Suptaghna, यज्ञकोपः Yajnakopa, च and, दुर्मुखः Durmukha, दूषणः Dushana, खरः Khara, त्रिशिराः Trishira, करवीराक्षः Karaviraksha, सूर्यशत्रुः Suryashatru, च and, राक्षसः rakshasa.
explanation: Among the other rakshasas were Suptaghna, Yajnakopa, Durmukha, Dushana, Khara, Trishira, Karaviraksha, and Suryashatru.

shloka_text: महाकायो ऽतिकायश्च देवान्तकनरान्तकौ । एतैः सर्वैः परिवृतो महावीर्यो महाबलः ।। 7.27.31 ।।
transliteration: mahākāyo 'tikāyaśca devāntakanarāntakau | etaiḥ sarvaiḥ parivṛto mahāvīryo mahābalaḥ || 7.27.31 ||
translation: महाकायो Mahakaya, अतिकायश्च Atikaya, देवान्तकनरान्तकौ Devantaka and Narantaka, एतैः by these, सर्वैः all, परिवृतो surrounded, महावीर्यो of great valor, महाबलः of great strength.
explanation: Surrounded by all these, namely Mahakaya, Atikaya, Devantaka, and Narantaka, was one of immense valor and strength.

shloka_text: रावणस्यार्यकः सैन्यं सुमाली प्रविवेश ह । स दैवतगणान्सर्वान्नानाप्रहरणैः शितैः । व्यध्वंसयत्सुसङ्क्रुद्धो वायुर्जलधरानिव ।। 7.27.32 ।।
transliteration: rāvaṇasyāryakaḥ sainyaṃ sumālī praviveśa ha | sa daivatagaṇānsarvānnānāpraharaṇaiḥ śitaiḥ | vyadhvaṃsayatsusaṅkruddho vāyurjaladharāniva || 7.27.32 ||
translation: रावणस्य Ravana's, आर्यकः grandfather, सैन्यं army, सुमाली Sumali, प्रविवेश entered, ह indeed, स He, दैवतगणान् hosts of gods, सर्वान् all, नानाप्रहरणैः with various weapons, शितैः sharp, व्यध्वंसयत् destroyed, सुसङ्क्रुद्धो greatly enraged, वायुर् wind, जलधरानिव like clouds.
explanation: Indeed, Sumali, Ravana's grandfather, entered the army and, greatly enraged, destroyed all the hosts of gods with sharp, various weapons, just as the wind scatters clouds.

shloka_text: तद्दैवतबलं राम हन्यमानं निशाचरैः । प्रणुन्नं सर्वतो दिग्भ्यः सिंहनुन्ना मृगा इव ।। 7.27.33 ।।
transliteration: taddaivatabalaṃ rāma hanyamānaṃ niśācaraiḥ | praṇunnaṃ sarvato digbhyaḥ siṃhanunnā mṛgā iva || 7.27.33 ||
translation: तत् That, दैवतबलं army of gods, राम O Rama, हन्यमानं being killed, निशाचरैः by the night-wanderers, प्रणुन्नं driven away, सर्वतो from all, दिग्भ्यः directions, सिंहनुन्ना driven by lions, मृगा deer, इव like.
explanation: O Rama, that army of gods, being killed by the night-wanderers, was driven away from all directions, just like deer are scattered by lions.

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे शूरो वसूनामष्टमो वसुः । सावित्र इति विख्यातः प्रविवेश रणाजिरम् ।। 7.27.34 ।।
transliteration: etasminnantare śūro vasūnāmaṣṭamo vasuḥ | sāvitra iti vikhyātaḥ praviveśa raṇājiram || 7.27.34 ||
translation: एतस्मिन् In this, अन्तरे interval, शूरो brave, वसूनाम् among the Vasus, अष्टमो eighth, वसुः Vasu, सावित्र Savitra, इति thus, विख्यातः renowned, प्रविवेश entered, रणाजिरम् the battlefield.
explanation: In this interval, the brave eighth Vasu, renowned as Savitra, entered the battlefield.

shloka_text: तथा ऽ ऽदित्यौ महावीर्यौ त्वष्टा पूषा च दंशितौ । निंर्भयौ सह सैन्येन तदा प्राविशतां रणे ।। 7.27.35 ।।
transliteration: tathā ' 'dityau mahāvīryau tvaṣṭā pūṣā ca daṃśitau | niṃrbhayau saha sainyena tadā prāviśatāṃ raṇe || 7.27.35 ||
translation: तथा Likewise, आदित्यौ the two Adityas, महावीर्यौ of great valor, त्वष्टा Tvashta, पूषा Pushan, च and, दंशितौ armored, निंर्भयौ fearless, सह with, सैन्येन their army, तदा then, प्राविशतां entered, रणे into battle.
explanation: Likewise, the two Adityas of great valor, Tvashta and Pushan, armored and fearless, then entered the battle with their army.

shloka_text: ततो युद्धं समभवत्सुराणां सह राक्षसैः । क्रुद्धानां रक्षसां कीर्तिं समरेष्वनिवर्तिनाम् ।। 7.27.36 ।।
transliteration: tato yuddhaṃ samabhavatsurāṇāṃ saha rākṣasaiḥ | kruddhānāṃ rakṣasāṃ kīrtiṃ samareṣvanivartinām || 7.27.36 ||
translation: ततः then, युद्धम् battle, समभवत् occurred, सुराणाम् of the gods, सह with, राक्षसैः the demons, क्रुद्धानाम् of the enraged, रक्षसाम् of the demons, कीर्तिम् fame, समरेषु in battles, अनिवर्तिनाम् of those who do not retreat.
explanation: Then a battle took place between the gods and the demons, who were enraged and renowned for never retreating from combat.

shloka_text: ततस्ते राक्षसाः सर्वे विबुधान्समरे स्थितान् । नानाप्रहरणैर्घोरैर्जघ्नुः शतसहस्रशः ।। 7.27.37 ।।
transliteration: tataste rākṣasāḥ sarve vibudhānsamare sthitān | nānāpraharaṇairghorairjaghnuḥ śatasahasraśaḥ || 7.27.37 ||
translation: ततः then, ते those, राक्षसाः demons, सर्वे all, विबुधान् the gods, समरे in battle, स्थितान् standing, नानाप्रहरणैः with various weapons, घोरैः terrible, जघ्नुः struck, शतसहस्रशः by hundreds of thousands.
explanation: Then all those demons, using dreadful and various weapons, struck down the gods arrayed in battle by hundreds of thousands.

shloka_text: देवाश्च राक्षसान्घोरान्महाबलपराक्रमान् । समरे विमलैः शस्त्रैरुपनिन्युर्यमक्षयम् ।। 7.27.38 ।।
transliteration: devāśca rākṣasānghorānmahābalaparākramān | samare vimalaiḥ śastrairupaninyuryamakṣayam || 7.27.38 ||
translation: देवाः the gods, च and, राक्षसान् the demons, घोरान् dreadful, महाबलपराक्रमान् of great strength and valor, समरे in battle, विमलैः with pure, शस्त्रैः weapons, उपनिन्युः led, यमक्षयम् to Yama's abode.
explanation: And the gods, in battle, with their pure weapons, led the dreadful demons of great strength and valor to the abode of Yama.

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राम सुमाली नाम राक्षसः । नानाप्रहरणैः क्रुद्धस्तत्सैन्यं सो ऽभ्यवर्तत ।। 7.27.39 ।।
transliteration: etasminnantare rāma sumālī nāma rākṣasaḥ | nānāpraharaṇaiḥ kruddhastatsainyaṃ so 'bhyavartata || 7.27.39 ||
translation: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, राम O Rama, सुमाली Sumali, नाम named, राक्षसः demon, नानाप्रहरणैः with various weapons, क्रुद्धः enraged, तत् that, सैन्यम् army, सः he, अभ्यवर्तत attacked.
explanation: O Rama, in the meantime, a demon named Sumali, enraged and wielding various weapons, attacked that army.

shloka_text: स दैवतबलं सर्वं नानाप्रहणैः शितैः । व्यध्वंसयत सङ्क्रुद्धो वायुर्जलधरं यथा ।। 7.27.40 ।।
transliteration: sa daivatabalaṃ sarvaṃ nānāprahaṇaiḥ śitaiḥ | vyadhvaṃsayata saṅkruddho vāyurjaladharaṃ yathā || 7.27.40 ||
translation: सः he, दैवतबलम् the army of gods, सर्वम् all, नानाप्रहणैः with various weapons, शितैः sharp, व्यध्वंसयत destroyed, सङ्क्रुद्धः greatly enraged, वायुः wind, जलधरम् a cloud, यथा just as.
explanation: Greatly enraged, he destroyed the entire army of gods with his sharp, various weapons, just as the wind scatters a cloud.

shloka_text: ते महाबाणवर्षैश्च शूलप्रासैः सुदारुणैः । हन्यमानाः सुराः सर्वे न व्यतिष्ठन्त संहताः ।। 7.27.41 ।।
transliteration: te mahābāṇavarṣaiśca śūlaprāsaiḥ sudāruṇaiḥ | hanyamānāḥ surāḥ sarve na vyatiṣṭhanta saṃhatāḥ || 7.27.41 ||
translation: ते they, महाबाणवर्षैः by great showers of arrows, च and, शूलप्रासैः by spears and javelins, सुदारुणैः very terrible, हन्यमानाः being struck, सुराः gods, सर्वे all, न not, व्यतिष्ठन्त stood firm, संहताः united.
explanation: All the gods, being struck by the very terrible great showers of arrows and spears and javelins, could not stand firm together.

shloka_text: ततो विद्राव्यमाणेषु दैवतेषु सुमालिना । वसूनामष्टमः क्रुद्धः सावित्रो वै व्यवस्थितः ।। 7.27.42 ।।
transliteration: tato vidrāvyamāṇeṣu daivateṣu sumālinā | vasūnāmaṣṭamaḥ kruddhaḥ sāvitro vai vyavasthitaḥ || 7.27.42 ||
translation: ततः then, विद्राव्यमाणेषु while being put to flight, दैवतेषु the gods, सुमालिना by Sumali, वसूनाम् among the Vasus, अष्टमः the eighth, क्रुद्धः enraged, सावित्रः Savitra, वै indeed, व्यवस्थितः stood firm.
explanation: Then, as the gods were being put to flight by Sumali, Savitra, the eighth among the Vasus, enraged, stood firm.

shloka_text: संवृतः स्वैरथानीकैः प्रहरन्तं निशाचरम् । विक्रमेण महातेजा वारयामास संयुगे ।। 7.27.43 ।।
transliteration: saṃvṛtaḥ svairathānīkaiḥ praharantaṃ niśācaram | vikrameṇa mahātejā vārayāmāsa saṃyuge || 7.27.43 ||
translation: संवृतः surrounded, स्वैरथानीकैः by his own chariot divisions, प्रहरन्तं striking, निशाचरम् the night-ranger, विक्रमेण with valor, महातेजा the greatly effulgent one, वारयामास checked, संयुगे in battle.
explanation: The greatly effulgent Savitra, surrounded by his own chariot divisions, checked the attacking demon with his valor in battle.

shloka_text: ततस्तयोर्महायुद्धमभवद्रोमहर्षणम् ।। 7.27.44 ।।
transliteration: tatastayormahāyuddhamabhavadromaharṣaṇam || 7.27.44 ||
translation: ततः then, तयोः between those two, महायुद्धम् a great battle, अभवत् occurred, रोमहर्षणम् hair-raising.
explanation: Then, a great and hair-raising battle occurred between those two.

shloka_text: सुमालिनो वसोश्चैव समरेष्वनिवर्तिनोः । ततस्तस्य महाबाणैर्वसुना सुमहात्मना । निहतः पन्नगरथः क्षणेन विनिपातितः ।। 7.27.45 ।।
transliteration: sumālino vasoścaiva samareṣvanivartinoḥ | tatastasya mahābāṇairvasunā sumahātmanā | nihataḥ pannagarathaḥ kṣaṇena vinipātitaḥ || 7.27.45 ||
translation: सुमालिनः of Sumali, वसोः of Vasu, च and, एव indeed, समरेषु in battles, अनिवर्तिनोः who do not retreat, ततः then, तस्य his (Sumali's), महाबाणैः by great arrows, वसुना by Vasu, सुमहात्मना by the very great-souled one, निहतः struck down, पन्नगरथः whose chariot was drawn by serpents, क्षणेन in a moment, विनिपातितः was overthrown.
explanation: Then, in a moment, the chariot of Sumali, who, along with Vasu, did not retreat in battles, was struck down and overthrown by the great arrows of the very great-souled Vasu.

shloka_text: हत्वा तु संयुगे तस्य रथं बाणशतैश्चितम् । गदां तस्य वधार्थाय वसुर्जग्राह पाणिना ।। 7.27.46 ।।
transliteration: hatvā tu saṃyuge tasya rathaṃ bāṇaśataiścitam | gadāṃ tasya vadhārthāya vasurjagrāha pāṇinā || 7.27.46 ||
translation: हत्वा having destroyed, तु indeed, संयुगे in battle, तस्य his, रथं chariot, बाणशतैश्चितम् covered with hundreds of arrows, गदां mace, तस्य his, वधार्थाय for the purpose of killing, वसुः Vasu, जग्राह took, पाणिना with his hand.
explanation: Vasu, having destroyed Sumali's chariot which was covered with hundreds of arrows in battle, then took up his mace with his hand for the purpose of killing him.

shloka_text: ततः प्रगृह्य दीप्ताग्रां कालदण्डोपमां गदाम् । तां मूर्ध्नि पातयामास सावित्रो वै सुमालिनः ।। 7.27.47 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ pragṛhya dīptāgrāṃ kāladaṇḍopamāṃ gadām | tāṃ mūrdhni pātayāmāsa sāvitro vai sumālinaḥ || 7.27.47 ||
translation: ततः then, प्रगृह्य having grasped, दीप्ताग्रां having a blazing tip, कालदण्डोपमां resembling the staff of Yama, गदाम् mace, तां that, मूर्ध्नि on the head, पातयामास he struck down, सावित्रो Savitri's son (Vasu), वै indeed, सुमालिनः of Sumali.
explanation: Then, Savitri's son Vasu, having firmly grasped that mace with its blazing tip resembling the staff of Yama, struck it down upon Sumali's head.

shloka_text: सा तस्योपरि चोल्काभा पतन्तीव बभौ गदा । इन्द्रप्रमुक्ता गर्जन्ती गिराविव महाशनिः ।। 7.27.48 ।।
transliteration: sā tasyopari colkābhā patantīva babhau gadā | indrapramuktā garjantī girāviva mahāśaniḥ || 7.27.48 ||
translation: सा that, तस्योपरि upon him, च and, उल्काभा resembling a meteor, पतन्तीव as if falling, बभौ shone, गदा mace, इन्द्रप्रमुक्ता released by Indra, गर्जन्ती roaring, गिराविव as if on a mountain, महाशनिः a great thunderbolt.
explanation: That mace, resembling a falling meteor, shone as it descended upon him, like a great thunderbolt released by Indra roaring down upon a mountain.

shloka_text: तस्य नैवास्थि न शिरो न मांसं ददृशे तदा । गदया भस्मतां नीतं निहतस्य रणाजिरे ।। 7.27.49 ।।
transliteration: tasya naivāsthi na śiro na māṃsaṃ dadṛśe tadā | gadayā bhasmatāṃ nītaṃ nihatasya raṇājire || 7.27.49 ||
translation: तस्य his, नैव neither, अस्थि bone, न nor, शिरो head, न nor, मांसं flesh, ददृशे was seen, तदा then, गदया by the mace, भस्मतां to ashes, नीतं brought, निहतस्य of the one killed, रणाजिरे in the battlefield.
explanation: Then, neither his bone, nor head, nor flesh was seen, as the mace had reduced the slain Sumali to ashes on the battlefield.

shloka_text: तं दृष्ट्वा निहतं सङ्ख्ये राक्षसास्ते समन्ततः । व्यद्रवन्सहिताः सर्वे क्रोशमानाः परस्परम् । विद्राव्यमाणा वसुना राक्षसा नावतस्थिरे ।। 7.27.50 ।।
transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā nihataṃ saṅkhye rākṣasāste samantataḥ | vyadravansahitāḥ sarve krośamānāḥ parasparam | vidrāvyamāṇā vasunā rākṣasā nāvatasthire || 7.27.50 ||
translation: तं him, दृष्ट्वा having seen, निहतं killed, सङ्ख्ये in battle, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, ते those, समन्ततः from all sides, व्यद्रवन् they fled, सहिताः together, सर्वे all, क्रोशमानाः crying out, परस्परम् to each other, विद्राव्यमाणा being put to flight, वसुना by Vasu, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, न not, अवतस्थिरे stood firm.
explanation: Having seen Sumali killed in battle, all those Rakshasas fled together from all sides, crying out to each other, and being driven away by Vasu, they could not stand firm.
